sys_atf_test.name: DDI negative: requester cannot self-approve (SoD)
sys_atf_test.description: The requester submits, then (still as the requester) attempts to approve their own request; assert the approval cannot be granted by them and the request does not advance.

sys_atf_step.description: As the requester, attempt to approve the pending approval; assert it is NOT permitted (the requester is not an approver, so no approval record is assigned to them, or the attempt is rejected). The approval must remain 'requested'.
Assert the request did not advance (not closed complete) while unapproved.
